dashboard.title: SOC 2 readiness controls
dashboard.subtitle: Internal view of control status and evidence freshness. Staff only.
dashboard.notice: This is readiness tracking, not a SOC 2 report. Vireek has not completed an audit. “Met” means implemented in the repository with automated evidence; it does not mean audited.

error.title: Could not load controls
error.body: The control list could not be loaded. You may not have staff access, or the database migration has not been applied.

empty.title: No controls synced yet
empty.body: Run the “sync” step of the evidence workflow to load docs/compliance/soc2/controls.json into the database.

table.caption: SOC 2 controls with declared status and evidence state

claims.heading: What we can show evidence for
claims.intro: Each item is marked “Evidenced” only while automated checks keep confirming it. Anything else stays “In progress”.
claims.footnote: This is not a SOC 2 report or certification. Vireek has not completed a SOC 2 audit.

tenant_isolation_rls.title: Account isolation in the database
tenant_isolation_rls.body: Every application table has row-level security enabled, checked automatically.

automated_security_scanning.title: Automated security scanning
automated_security_scanning.body: Dependency audit, code analysis and secret scanning run on a schedule and on code changes, with no critical or high findings past our target fix times.

automated_ci_checks.title: Automated checks on code changes
automated_ci_checks.body: Linting, type checks, tests and builds run automatically, and recent runs on the main branch are passing.

availability_monitoring.title: Continuous call-answering monitoring
availability_monitoring.body: Synthetic test calls and service-level objectives monitor whether the AI answers calls; probes ran within the last day.

vulnerability_disclosure.title: Security contact and disclosure policy
vulnerability_disclosure.body: A security.txt file and a vulnerability disclosure page are published and current.

backup_and_restore_testing.title: Backups and restore testing
backup_and_restore_testing.body: Application backups complete at least daily and a restore drill has passed within the last eight days.

enforced_mfa_for_staff.title: Multi-factor authentication for Vireek staff
enforced_mfa_for_staff.body: Every Vireek staff account has a verified second factor enrolled.

independent_penetration_test.title: Independent penetration test
independent_penetration_test.body: A third-party penetration test has been completed and recorded.
